title: HR PC gets an IP but cannot reach the file server in VLAN 30
symptom: PC-HR in VLAN 20 has a valid IP address and can ping its own default gateway, but every attempt to reach the file server SRV-FILES at 192.168.30.10 times out. Users in Sales report the same problem reaching that server. Nothing was changed on the PCs.
topology_note: Single multilayer switch lab (simulated). SW1 is a Catalyst 3560 doing inter-VLAN routing with ip routing enabled. VLAN 10 SALES = 192.168.10.0/24, VLAN 20 HR = 192.168.20.0/24, VLAN 30 SERVERS = 192.168.30.0/24. PC-SALES on Gi0/3 in VLAN 10, PC-HR on Gi0/1 in VLAN 20, SRV-FILES on Gi0/2 in VLAN 30. Each VLAN is supposed to have an SVI on SW1 acting as its default gateway. No router and no ACLs are present in this lab.

expected_fault: VLAN 30 was never created in the VLAN database on SW1. The Vlan30 SVI exists and holds 192.168.30.1/24 but is administratively shut down, so the SERVERS subnet has no active gateway, SW1 has no connected route to 192.168.30.0/24, and access port Gi0/2 shows Access Mode VLAN 30 as Inactive.
expected_fix_steps: On SW1, create the missing VLAN: configure terminal / vlan 30 / name SERVERS / exit
Bring up the gateway: interface Vlan30 / no shutdown / exit
Verify the VLAN database: show vlan brief (VLAN 30 must appear as active with Gi0/2)
Verify the SVI: show ip interface brief (Vlan30 must be up/up)
Verify routing: show ip route (192.168.30.0/24 must appear as directly connected)
Confirm the fix from the client: ping 192.168.30.10 from PC-HR

intended_flows.note: HR staff must reach the file server
Inter-VLAN traffic between Sales and HR is allowed in this lab
